issues.issue: Is the appeal of this interlocutory s.77 order barred by IRPA s.79, and does an exception apply?
issues.applicant_position: The order breaches his solicitor-client privilege (Charter ss.7, 8), so it is beyond jurisdiction and appealable.
issues.respondent_position: Section 79 bars the appeal; there is no constitutional right of appeal and no jurisdictional error.
issues.result_quote: I would quash the appeal for want of jurisdiction.

issues.issue: Should the court decide the merits of the privilege-breach grounds on the order's prejudice test and practicality?
issues.applicant_position: Seeks to set aside the order and have the permanent stay motion decided before any document separation.
issues.respondent_position: Justice Blanchard has not yet found any privilege breach, and the order is within his jurisdiction.
issues.result_quote: would require this Court to make a decision on the basis of a factual foundation that is, to say the least, incomplete.
